description: This file is a C source file implementing DRM platform initialization, deinitialization, and a proxy for decrypting opaque content in a PlayReady DRM system. It contains functions for handling DRM setup/teardown and a decrypt call that involves converting secure pointers to buffer handles.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_init()
methods.description: Initializes the DRM PlayReady platform library, logs an initialization message.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_deinit()
methods.description: Deinitializes the DRM PlayReady platform library, logs a deinitialization message.
